name: enhanced-silverstripe-templates
description: Silverstripe Template Language Highlighter and Snippets
author: Emmanuel Davies

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting, indentation and formatting always work. Indexing PHP to resolve variables and includes only runs in trusted workspaces.

silverstripe.index.enable.markdownDescription: Index the workspace so `$Variables` and `<% include %>` names can be resolved to their definitions.

silverstripe.index.includeVendor.markdownDescription: Also index `vendor/*/*/src` and `vendor/*/*/code`, so members inherited from `SiteTree` and `DataObject` resolve. Turn off on very large projects.

silverstripe.index.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of PHP files to index per pass.

silverstripe.links.enable.markdownDescription: Show Ctrl/Cmd-clickable links for `<% include %>` names and `<% require %>` paths.

silverstripe.hover.enable.description: Show hover documentation for template variables.

silverstripe.php.format.enable.markdownDescription: Provide an indentation-only **Format Document** for PHP files. It rewrites leading whitespace and nothing else, so it composes with a style fixer such as PHP-CS-Fixer. If another extension already formats your PHP, set `editor.defaultFormatter` for `[php]` to choose between them, or turn this off.

silverstripe.format.normaliseTagSpacing.markdownDescription: When formatting, tidy whitespace inside tags so `<%if $X%>` becomes `<% if $X %>`.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
